description: Requires a JWT from a signed-in session (never a connected app or an rk_ key). Sets where your creator-sale shares (80% of each sale) and affiliate credits (25% of a referred buyer's first Studio month) are paid: a Solana wallet's main base58 address (not a token account, never one of Rokha's own wallets). "" clears it. Needs a claimed page (page_claim) — the address attaches to it. Changing an existing address pauses sends for 10 minutes. Rokha runs no other payouts.

address.description: A Solana wallet address (base58), or "" to clear.
